rationale: The run likely hit Moncler’s cookie and/or locale gate, causing a redirect to the home page under /en-de and preventing PLP tiles from rendering. We add safe overrides to accept OneTrust cookies, continue past the locale modal, enforce the intended locale prefix (/en-de), and make the crawler sticky to the requested PLP path. Additional PLP/PDP selector fallbacks match Moncler’s grid and product tile patterns, improving resilience when class names vary.
code_hints: After page.goto, try clicking '#onetrust-accept-btn-handler' if present; do not wait forever (timeout ~3s).
If a locale/country modal appears (buttons with data-testid containing 'locale' or 'country'), click the primary continue/confirm button before PLP checks.
If you land on https://www.moncler.com/en-de/ (home) instead of the PLP, immediately navigate back to the original PLP path (sticky category) once consents are handled.

Wait for one of the PLP grid selectors ([data-testid='product-grid'], #product-grid, .product-grid). If none appears within plp_wait_ms, treat as PLP-not-materialized and retry once after consent/locale actions.
Scroll the PLP to trigger lazy load before collecting tiles; require at least 1 product element before extracting links.
On PDP, read title with h1[data-testid='product-name'] fallback to h1.product-name; price from [data-testid='price'] then fallbacks.
